## Type of change

- [ ] Protocol compatibility
- [ ] Routing or failover
- [ ] Dashboard or usage accounting
- [ ] Configuration or deployment
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance

## Tests

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Manual gateway check, if relevant

## Compatibility checklist

- [ ] Responses API behavior is preserved, if relevant.
- [ ] Chat Completions behavior is preserved, if relevant.
- [ ] Streaming and non-streaming behavior are considered, if relevant.
- [ ] Token usage and cost accounting remain correct, if relevant.
- [ ] Upstream failover and circuit breaker behavior remain safe, if relevant.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No real API keys, bearer tokens, local databases, logs, or runtime state are included.
- [ ] Provider-specific examples use placeholders or are intentionally documented.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for public behavior or configuration changes.
